amcrest outdoor bullet right.text: The scene shows a single-family property with a detached garage on the left (white walls, tan shingled roof, multiple garage doors) fronting a paved public road/sidewalk that runs horizontally across the frame, while the sloping, leaf-strewn yard, the driveway apron, and the low white picket fence in the lower-right foreground constitute the private property. Mature deciduous trees and shrubs line the lot and the roadside, with a small ornamental tree with reddish foliage standing between the driveway and the road, and the gray SUV is parked along the public street while the white SUV sits on the private driveway. By day the image is in full color, showing autumn foliage and clear surface detail; by night the same fixed view is rendered in infrared grayscale, with the garage area washed out by a bright light source and the white SUV's headlights and open door creating glare. The permanent layout—garage, road, driveway, fence, and tree line—remains identical between the two frames, with only the vehicles, lighting, and a person at the garage door changing.
